# Orders architecture

## Context
Buyer uses Orders API; API calls Bank.

## Containers
Orders API stores orders in Orders DB and synchronously calls Bank over HTTPS.

## Retry
On Bank timeout API retries once with the same idempotency key, then reports pending.

## Future queue
Proposed only: add Queue and Worker; no implementation or acceptance yet.

## Decision notes
The original author preferred synchronous calls for easier reconciliation. Approval and date unknown.

## Changes
Initial baseline; retry added later. No unique decision rationale in this chronology.
